scope: Public-source research schema for Lola Young and publicly documented professional associations; immersive technology metadata is technical and not evidence of personal involvement.

subject.identity_disambiguation: English singer-songwriter; distinguish from similarly named people using source context.

association_schema.notes: Association does not imply endorsement, friendship, criminal conduct, or private relationship.

celebrity_discovery_rules.include: Publicly documented professional or event-based connections supported by sources.
celebrity_discovery_rules.exclude: Rumor-only relationships, private social graphs, inferred friendships, private contact data, and unverified allegations.

vMeta.definition: Virtual/metaverse metadata namespace used here for digital-world entities and relationships.

vCode.definition: Virtual-world code metadata namespace; analyze source structure rather than execute unknown code.

location_schema.private_location_policy: Do not infer or collect private residence/current-location information.

neural_boundary: No neural activity, mental state, medical condition, or cognitive state is inferred from music, social media, avatars, AR/VR activity, photographs, or public behavior.
security_boundary: Do not execute unknown vCode, retrieve credentials, bypass platform controls, deanonymize users, or access private systems. Static code metadata may be recorded for authorized source code.
factuality_rule: A celebrity appearing in the same event, platform, article, or dataset does not establish a personal relationship. Record the exact documented relationship and source evidence instead.
